component.name: PaneLive Companion
component.summary: Secure mobile production control and monitoring

description.p: PaneLive Companion provides secure device pairing, production control and monitoring, and a standalone teleprompter for mobile clients. It supports OBS Studio, vMix on Windows, and Streamlabs Desktop on Windows and macOS, with features varying by backend.
The Linux version supports OBS Studio and the standalone teleprompter. A separately installed OBS helper provides Program and Studio Preview monitoring over WebRTC.
